xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5637: Merge train never admits a polyrepo issue that touches a member repo with no CI

plan.title: Merge train never admits a polyrepo issue that touches a member repo with no CI
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5640 (follow-up: polyrepo promote reads MRs at the root)
PAN-5638 (sibling: GitHub member PRs in the ready set)

narratives.Problem: The merge-train ready set (src/lib/overdeck/ready-set.ts gitlabRows, line 164) requires checks === 'green' on every open MR of a polyrepo issue. A member repo with no CI never has a pipeline, so gitLabChecks returns 'none' and the issue is never ready, never queued, never merged. MYN's infra (eltmon/myn-infra) and docs (eltmon/mind-your-now-docs) have no .gitlab-ci.yml, so MIN-1144 and MIN-1146 (api green + infra none) are shut out. The merge gate (evaluateMergeReadiness, pr-facts.ts line 963) refuses 'none' the same way, which blocks an infra-only or docs-only issue whose facts come from the CI-less repo. The 'none is not green' rule must not loosen for repos that do run CI.
narratives.Proposal: Add an explicit, per-repo positive signal: workspace.repos[].ci: none in projects.yaml. resolveConfiguredRepos carries it as ciNone: true. A new import-free module src/lib/cloister/member-ci.ts holds the one predicate checksPass({checks, ciNone}) (green passes; none passes only with ciNone; red/pending never) and withMemberCi(facts, repo). The ready set's gitlabRows, the merge gate (readPrFacts stamps PrFacts.ciNone from the GitLab member it read; evaluateMergeReadiness uses checksPass), and the merge-train board's two checks tests all call checksPass. PrFacts.checks stays the forge's honest verdict. pr-facts.ts stays at <= 1000 lines. Docs (configuration/polyrepo.mdx, docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md) and changelog.d/pan-5637.md describe the field, and the operator config sets ci: none on MYN's infra and docs entries.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to githubRows in ready-set.ts (PAN-5638 owns it; the GitHub listing maps an empty rollup to 'pending', not 'none')
- ci: none has no effect on GitHub member repos or on GitLab/GitHub monorepos
- No change to polyrepo batch promote or getDerivedIssueState (tracked as PAN-5640); this issue does not promise that MIN-1144/MIN-1146 merge
- No rewriting of PrFacts.checks: the forge verdict 'none' is reported as 'none' everywhere
- red and pending checks are never waived, with or without ci: none
- No change to mergeabilityPending, withForgeApprovalAtHead, evaluateConflictRepairGate, blockerReasonsFor or deriveState
- No new value of ci besides 'none'; no validation, warning or pan doctor check for unknown values
- No new forge (gh/glab) reads
- No file-size allowlist row and no extraction of other code out of pr-facts.ts
- Auricle's infra entry and every non-MYN project config stay unchanged
- No change to how the gate picks which member MR to read (first writable GitLab member with an MR)

autoDecisions.summary: Config field is workspace.repos[].ci with the single recognized value 'none'; anything else is ignored silently.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue proposes exactly this field and value; a closed single value keeps the waiver an explicit positive statement and avoids a validation surface nobody asked for.

autoDecisions.summary: Only checks 'none' is waived; 'red' and 'pending' still block on a ci: none repo.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's constraint is that the absence-of-evidence rule must not loosen beyond the declared case; a repo that later gains a failing pipeline must still stop the merge.

autoDecisions.summary: PrFacts.checks keeps the forge's verdict; the waiver is applied at judgment time through one predicate, checksPass, in a new import-free module member-ci.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rewriting checks to 'green' would lie to every UI consumer; one predicate keeps the ready set, gate and board in agreement; a new module keeps pr-facts.ts under its 1000-line ceiling and avoids an import cycle.

autoDecisions.summary: The gate learns the member from readPrFacts, which stamps ciNone on facts read from a GitLab member declaring ci: none.
autoDecisions.rationale: readPrFacts already holds the ResolvedProjectRepo it found the MR in; no extra forge read or remote-matching is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: The waiver is honored for GitLab members only; githubRows is untouched.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5638 is rewriting githubRows' approval rule concurrently, and the GitHub listing never reports 'none' for an open PR (empty rollup maps to 'pending'), so a GitHub waiver would need a different design.

autoDecisions.summary: The merge-train board's two checks tests (lines 294, 424) switch to checksPass.
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise the board shows a car the ready set admitted as checks-pending; it is a two-line change on the same facts.

autoDecisions.summary: Polyrepo batch promote (derived state reads MRs at the polyrepo root) is out of scope and filed as PAN-5640.
autoDecisions.rationale: A read-only probe returned pr: null for MIN-1144 and MIN-1146; the defect is unrelated to CI, and folding it in would double the change surface.

autoDecisions.summary: The work agent edits ~/.overdeck/projects.yaml itself (with a dated backup) to add ci: none to MYN infra and docs, inside the docs item.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for it; the field is ignored by the old code, so the edit is safe before deploy; agents do console/config steps themselves (operator memory).

autoDecisions.summary: ciNone is added by conditional spread only when true, never as ciNone: false.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps every existing toEqual assertion on resolved repos and ready-set repos unchanged (NFR-1).

Add checksPass and withMemberCi in an import-free member-ci module

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/cloister/member-ci.ts with the module header and exactly the two exports shown in the PRD: `checksPass(facts: { readonly checks: string; readonly ciNone?: boolean }): boolean` returning `facts.checks === 'green' || (facts.checks === 'none' && facts.ciNone === true)`, and `withMemberCi<T extends object>(facts: T, repo: { readonly ciNone?: boolean }): T` returning `{ ...facts, ciNone: true }` when repo.ciNone === true, else the same facts object. The module has no import statements (not even type imports from pr-facts.ts). Add src/lib/cloister/__tests__/member-ci.test.ts with the four named cases.

Tests: in pr-facts-gitlab-gate.test.ts give the deps helper an optional third parameter `repo: { ciNone?: boolean } = {}` spread into the resolved repo, and add the three named cases (ciNone + no pipeline -> ready; no ciNone -> 'no CI checks reported'; ciNone + failed pipeline -> 'CI checks failing'). In merge-gate.test.ts add the evaluateIssueMergeGate case using readyFacts('MIN-9', { forge: 'gitlab', checks: 'none', ciNone: true }) -> ready, and without ciNone -> not ready with /no CI checks reported/.
